verdict.rationale: Bitwarden's integrated authenticator generates TOTP codes from the vault, and Authenticator can sync codes with Password Manager. Vault export is documented for backup and transfer, which implies codes can be restored on a new device by syncing or re-importing. However, no evidence documents an explicit lost-phone recovery walkthrough, so coverage is partial. missing for 10: an explicit documented lost-device recovery flow for TOTP tokens, confirmation that synced codes restore automatically on a fresh device, and independent hands-on corroboration of recovery.

support.subject: As an everyday user, losing my phone doesn't lose my accounts — a documented recovery path restores my tokens on a new device

citations.quote: Connect Authenticator with Password Manager to sync your verification codes. Once activated, the Bitwarden apps stay synchronized with any codes you add or edit
it automatically produces the time-based one-time passwords (TOTPs)
Export your vault data, including logins and notes, to back up important information or transfer to a new Bitwarden vault.
